flags.why: This verb belongs to formal historical and political writing rather than everyday conversation ([usage reference](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/duy-tan-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The noun likewise belongs to formal historical and political contexts ([usage reference](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/duy-tan-tieng-anh-la-gi)).

This expression disparages someone as lazy and burdensome, so informal alone does not warn learners that it is insulting ([usage example](https://vanvn.vn/an-uc-nhuc-tinh-va-sex-trong-tho-nguyen-binh/)).
It denotes a male flower cluster, not a young fruit ([botanical reference](https://rttc.hcmuaf.edu.vn/rttc-8154-1/vn/cay-mit.html)).
flags.fix: male jackfruit flower cluster (the small non-fruiting spike on a jackfruit tree)
